title: Radiant Nuclear video stories
description: A sandy tan band with white type: an opening paragraph, then a run of film stories, each a full-bleed 16:9 video followed by a bold all-caps two-line heading, a short paragraph and a flat dark button. On wide screens each story becomes a row (video on one half, text on the other), alternating sides.
notes: uses the theme's secondary colour as the band and secondary-foreground for the type
the videos are slots: pass a looping muted
no motion besides the button hover (the original's videos loop on their own)
